payload.feedback:
Revise. Much of this plan is accurate, but the statements below are false at 0a7f2a7a21da745f0cee16fff76dc36c13d01c39. Correct each one from the checkout, not from memory, and keep everything that is accurate.
The rule for this revision: name a file, function, type, route, table, field, value, script or test only if you opened the file and saw it there; otherwise describe the behaviour in plain words or leave it out. Keep the plan under 25,000 characters, and write it once, as one JSON object, at the end of your turn.
1. README.md: the authority notice is lines 7 to 11, not 3 to 9, and ## Verifying has no numbered items 9 and 10. Quote only text you read there.
2. There is no npm run verify. The scripts are npm run gate:verify-check (scripts/verify-check.sh) and npm run gate:path-audit (scripts/path-audit.sh); read package.json.
3. packages/journal/src/codec.ts does not exist. The command-event row encoding is in packages/journal/src/event-row.ts.
4. GatewayPlannerPollMessage and GatewayPlannerReportMessage do not exist. The signed envelopes are PlannerPollEnvelope and PlannerReportEnvelope in packages/gateway-protocol/src/envelope.ts.
5. There is no append_build_room_plan. The same-transaction xmin check is a query in packages/control-plane/src/plan-store.ts.
6. The loop method is PlannerLoop.runRound; runPlannerRound does not exist.
7. Nothing sets app.journal_writer. The identity latch in journal-store.ts refuses to append unless session_user and current_user are br_app_runtime.
8. awaitPlan does not return raw output, and the executor does not return raw stdout: the Gateway parses the answer and returns the plan document.
9. T5 moves PLAN_REVIEW to BUILDING and T22 moves the room to CLOSED_ABANDONED (packages/contracts/src/transitions.ts). There are no PLAN_APPROVED or CANCELLED states.
10. There is no pre_send_refusal: a refusal before sending is journaled as failed with authorization_does_not_cover, authorization_indeterminate, attestation_failed or identity_mismatch (PLANNER_FAILURES in planner-loop.ts). planner.plan_refused is written only when judgeRoundPlan refuses a plan (plan_invalid, plan_outside_captured_scope), and its reason kinds are schema, scope_path, encoding, not_ready and outside_captured_scope. not_json, schema_invalid, terminal_status_not_ready and scope_mismatch do not exist, and a plan the plan store refuses for credential material writes no such line.
11. The runner never sends founder.cancel or any other decision, including when the live check fails (packages/run-harness/src/phase4/runner.ts).
12. There is no public.command_journal. The journal tables are command_journal_events and command_journal_chain_head.
13. The executor evidence directory is planner-evidence, not planner-executor-evidence.
14. The runner saves the plan as plan-<planHash>.json in PHASE4_EVIDENCE_DIR, not <label>-plan.json.
15. Seven of the twelve test files you name do not exist: test/planner-loop.test.ts, test/planner-recovery.test.ts, test/plan-store.test.ts, test/plan-read.test.ts, test/gateway-planner.test.ts, test/counted-run-config.test.ts and test/phase4-harness.test.ts. Files that do exist include test/planner-loop.storage.test.ts, test/planner-recovery.storage.test.ts, test/plan-store.storage.test.ts, test/gateway-planner-channel.test.ts, test/gateway-planner-protocol.test.ts, test/phase4-run-harness.test.ts and test/phase4-counted-run-cli.test.ts. List the test directory before naming a test.
Before returning the plan, check every name in it against the checkout, and remove any you did not see.

Revise. Your plan takes all 15 earlier corrections; keep them. But it adds new statements that are false at 0a7f2a7a21da745f0cee16fff76dc36c13d01c39, including some your previous plan had right. Correct each one from the checkout and keep everything that is accurate.
This is the final revision. Name fewer things: a README section does not need every function, constant and error code. Name a file, function, type, route, table, field, value, script or test only if you opened the file and saw it there, and only if the README section needs it; otherwise describe the behaviour in plain words or leave it out. Keep the plan under 25,000 characters; this one is about 34,000. Write it once, as one JSON object, at the end of your turn.
1. README.md has no ## Current status heading. The heading is ## Status, at line 52, and the Phase 4 paragraph and the PR 2b block sit under it.
2. The Not done bullet is line 143 alone; lines 136 to 142 are other bullets. It lists the Neon endpoint credential, sealing the two Railway tokens and the review-bot credentials. It does not list the planner loop, the PlanDoc schema or T4, T5 and T22. Read line 143 before deciding whether to change it.
3. The plan-decision route is behind PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN, and the counted-run routes are behind PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN (packages/control-plane/src/config.ts). CONTROL_PLANE_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN and BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN do not exist.
4. The counted-run act is one variable, PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN, which parseCountedRunConfig reads into an act id, a gateway id, the planner lane and the two seats. BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_ACT, BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_GATEWAY_ID, BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_COMMIT_SHA and BUILDROOM_COUNTED_RUN_FOUNDEROS_SHA do not exist.
5. The counted-run routes, in countedRunRouter (packages/control-plane/src/counted-run.ts), are POST and GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round and GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal, all behind the counted-run token. There is no /control-plane/counted-runs/ prefix, no entry route, no createCountedRunSurface and no readRoomJournal, and the journal route is not behind CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN. When the token or the act is missing the routes answer 503 counted_run_disabled or counted_run_not_configured; counted_run_not_enabled does not exist.
6. The events route refuses the planner events with 403 governed_path_required, using GOVERNED_PATH_EVENTS and requiresGovernedPath in governed-events.ts. GOVERNED_LIFECYCLE_EVENTS and governed_event_route_forbidden do not exist.
7. The founder_goal evidence entry has its ref set to the event id, not inline:facts.founderGoal.
8. There is no readRoomPlan and no state check on the plan read. planReadRouter (plan-read.ts) returns the plan under the latest T3, answering 404 plan_not_found when there is none and 409 plan_changed; state_has_no_plan does not exist.
9. plannerCommandIdFor takes roomId, the opening event id and an attempt number that defaults to 1, and hashes them with the prefix build-room/planner-command/v1. buildroom:planner-command:1 is wrong.
10. These names do not exist: withRoomFence (the loop uses ledger.underRoomLock), appendJournaledInTransaction and appendDecisionInTransaction (the journal joins a transaction through inTransaction(client), then appendJournaled or appendDecision), and preContactRefusal (the loop calls authorizeRoute). attest takes only the command id; the loop then compares the returned role, provider, model and surface.
11. There is no PlannerRecovery.reconcileAll. Its one method is recoverRoom(roomId), and nothing in the service calls it at startup; only tests do.
12. founder.cancel has one refusal: 409 founder_cancel_unavailable when the room has no planner command. While a command is still pending the cancel goes through as an unconfirmed cancel and the pending command is recorded unresolved. founder_cancel_command_in_flight and founder_cancel_no_planner_command do not exist.
13. agy is not run with chat, --print or --mode agent. Its pinned arguments, PINNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS, are --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --model gemini-4-argon-high --effort high --mode plan --sandbox --print-timeout 900s, and the module refuses to load unless the mode is plan. The reap command is sudo -n -u <planner user> -- /usr/bin/pkill -KILL -u <planner user>.
14. The evidence record holds commandId, executionId, startedAt, agySha256, initModel, conversationId, sent, endedAt, outcome, exitCode, signal and checkoutRemoved. It has no roomId, round, baseSha or providerConversationId.
15. The migrations run from 0001_ledger_core to 0010_plan_store. 0001_room_event_ledger and 0011_command_journal_c2_and_counted_run do not exist.
Before returning the plan, check every name in it against the checkout, and remove any you did not see.
